title: Steering Under Compression: Dose-Response, Capability Cost, and Failure Asymmetry in Quantized LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.06473v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference-time activation steering enables behavioral control of large language models without parameter modification, while post-training quantization reduces memory and compute costs for deployment. Despite their growing convergence in practice, the interaction between these two techniques remains uncharacterized. We systematically study activation steering under weight-only quantization (INT8 and NF4) across four open-weight 7-9B models and two behavioral targets: judged sentiment and judge-free reasoning length. Using an iso-effect framework that compares capability costs at matched behavioral effect, we find that sentiment steering survives quantization intact. After correcting a GSM8K parser artifact with a uniform v2.3.1 rescore, the pooled INT8 contrast is -0.010 (90% CI [-0.026, +0.007]), descriptively Equivalent under the preregistered three-label rule, while NF4 remains Inconclusive at -0.017 ([-0.067, +0.033]). translated_title: 压缩下的引导：量化大语言模型中的剂量-反应关系、能力代价与失败不对称性
translated_abstract: 推理时的激活引导能够在不修改模型参数的情况下实现对大语言模型的行为控制，而训练后量化则可降低模型部署时的内存和计算成本。尽管这两种技术在实际应用中日益交汇，但它们之间的相互作用尚未得到系统表征。我们系统研究了仅权重量化（INT8和NF4）下的激活引导，实验涵盖四个开放权重的7-9B模型以及两个行为目标：有判定的情感和无判定的推理长度。通过采用等效效应框架，在匹配的行为效应下比较能力代价，我们发现情感引导在量化后几乎完整保留。在使用统一的v2.3.1重新评分纠正GSM8K解析器伪影后，INT8下的合并对比值为-0.010（90%置信区间[-0.026, +0.007]），在预注册的三标签规则下达到描述性等效，而NF4在-0.017（[-0.067, +0.033]）处仍无定论。相比之下……
tldr: 该论文首次系统量化了激活引导与训练后量化（INT8/NF4）之间的交互作用，提出等效效应框架来衡量量化下的能力代价，发现情感引导在量化后几乎无损地保留，而不同行为目标之间存在失败不对称性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic characterization of the interaction between activation steering and post-training quantization (INT8/NF4), introducing an iso-effect framework to measure capability costs and showing that sentiment steering survives quantization intact while revealing failure asymmetry across behavioral targets.
